content: This anticipated regional expansion is primarily driven by ongoing infrastructure improvements and initiatives aimed at enhancing intra-regional trade [53] . Furthermore, the future of Africa's cross-border freight market is projected to expand at a compound annual growth rate of 4.70 percent between 2026 and 2035, further emphasizing the vital role of sustained infrastructure growth across the continent [55] . Moving forward, the true differentiators in this sector will be the successful integration of Artificial Intelligence-driven efficiencies, the capacity to safely and effectively manage the unique logistical demands of electric vehicles, and the strategic agility to capitalize on the expanding African cross-border trade networks.
